footprints.description: Pair of Littelfuse 111 501 PC fuse clips (01110501Z) for a 5 x 20 mm fuse, 2 holes per clip
footprints.note: datasheets/fuse/littelfuse/littelfuse-fuse-clip-111-datasheet.pdf p.1: 111 501 / 111 506 Recommended Mounting Dimensions: 4 holes, B = .74 in (Table 1, 5x20) = 18.796 mm between the two clips, 5.0 +.076/-.025 across (mid 5.0255), hole diameter 1.17 -> pad 1.17 + 0.7 = 1.87; pin 1 = the left clip, pin 2 = the right clip; body = B x fuse diameter 5.2; the clip is not a library part

footprints.description: Pair of Littelfuse 102 071 PC fuse clips (01020071Z) for a 1/4 x 1-1/4 in (6.3 x 32 mm) fuse, 2 legs per clip
footprints.note: datasheets/fuse/littelfuse/102-bt-series-datasheet.pdf p.1: 102 071 straight leads, Recommended Mounting Dimensions: 4 holes in a row, 1.98 DIA. holes, 7.62 between the two legs of a clip, "A" length for a 1 1/4 in nominal fuse = 1.347 in = 34.2138 mm between the outer legs -> x = +-17.1069 and +-9.4869; pad 1.98 + 0.7 = 2.68; pin 1 = the left clip, pin 2 = the right clip; body = A x fuse diameter 6.35; the clip is not a library part

footprints.note: datasheets/fuse/eaton/eaton-1axxxx-pcb-fuse-clips-atc-atm-blade-data-sheet.pdf p.9: Recommended pad layout 1A1907: A = 1.375 in (34.93 mm) for a 1-1/4 in fuse (31.8) between the outer holes, B = 0.295-0.305 in (7.49-7.75, mid 7.62) between the two holes of a clip, C 0.067-0.070 in (1.70-1.78, mid 1.74) -> pad 1.74 + 0.7 = 2.44; x = +-17.465 and +-9.845; pin 1 = the left clip, pin 2 = the right clip; body = A x fuse diameter 6.35; the clip is not a library part

footprints.description: Littelfuse 607 10 x 32 mm bend-cylinder fuse (UXTH tabs), four slotted holes, 24.5 mm between the tabs
footprints.note: datasheets/fuse/littelfuse/littelfuse-fuse-607-series-datasheet.pdf p.3: Recommended PCB Layout: four slots 1.3 x 3.0; 25.8 outer and 23.2 inner edge distance -> slot centres x = +-12.25 (tab spacing 24.5 +-0.5); 11.8 between the slot rows read as outer edge to outer edge -> slot centres y = +-4.4 (11.8 - 3.0 = 8.8; the dimension could also be centre to centre); pad = hole + 0.7: 2.0 x 3.7 stadium around the 1.3 x 3.0 slot; pin 1 = the left tab (two slots), pin 2 = the right tab; body 33.40 x 12.25 (UXTH)
